## STEP 0-2 — VALUATION ENGINE SELECTED

**Primary engine: Six-year explicit Owner-Earnings DCF (FY2026–FY2031) + mid-growth terminal value, cross-checked with (a) forward FCF-yield multiples, (b) reverse-DCF expectations gap, (c) scenario weighting.**

Rationale: RTX is a cash-generative business with a 3.1×-revenue backlog (defense = multi-year visibility; commercial aftermarket = multi-year cycle). A 6-year explicit window captures the guided period (2026), the consensus year (2027), and the first half of the 2027–2031 margin-expansion phase the market is paying for. Revenue is contract-backed; the swing factors are margin and the discount rate — exactly what the scenarios test. A pure single-stage FCF model would misprice the inflection. A sum-of-the-parts is impossible (no segment XBRL dimensions in pack — see Section 12).

## STEP 0-3 — CASH-FLOW DEFINITION

**Owner Earnings (OE) = Operating Cash Flow − Capital Expenditure − Stock-Based Compensation.**

- OCF is the cleanest earnings measure here (accruals ratio −0.023 — cash is ahead of GAAP profit).
- Capex = company-defined maintained + growth capex (matches pack FCF column).
- SBC = $0.52B in FY2025, must be subtracted from OCF because it is a real expense that was added back [pack Section 5 instruction]. SBC is expensed in GAAP net income but OCF adds it back; failure to subtract overstates cash available to shareholders by ~5%.
